name: bhu-rakshak-landslide-live
meaning: Relative landslide-likelihood score for one place and one day (trained ~1 landslide : 3 non-landslides) — not a real-world probability. "Elevated" = above the level reached on ~10% of ordinary monsoon days.
status: EXPERIMENTAL — second opinion for officers only; does not trigger alerts.

evaluation.method: Year-by-year backtest 2012–2016, trained only on earlier years; bias-free comparisons (same place other day; road-matched spot)

sources: NASA Global Landslide Catalog + hand-checked 2026 reports
Open-Meteo (ERA5 for training, forecast API live)
